learning_outcomes.text: Get acquainted with mathematical description of balance of mass, energy and momentum.
Understand of various physical parameters of fluid mechanics needed for solving problems.
Understand of the importance and applicability of fluid dynamics in processing materials.
Gain basic and advanced knowledge that result in critical understanding of the theory and principles of fluid dynamics.
Obtain specialized skills in solving problems in fluid dynamics – skills that required for research in order to develop new concepts and processes that can be integrated into different fields.
Search for, analysis and synthesis of data and information, with the use of the necessary technology.

syllabus_topics: Introductory Concepts (fluids and soft matter, polymers, colloids, etc)
Principal of mechanics of Newtonian fluids (liquids, laminar flows)
Conservation of Momentum, microscopic and macroscopic balances of forces and momentum
Boundary layers, hydrodynamics, external flow, friction coefficient
Special topics (turbulent flow, energy, time dependent flows)
bibliography: R. W. Fox, A. T. McDonald, P. J. Pritchard, Introduction to fluid mechanics, 6th ed., Wiley, NY, 2006.
Introduction to fluid mechanics, 3rd ed., W. S. Janna, PWS, Boston 1993
Fundamentals of Fluid Mechanics, by Munson, Okiishi, Huebsch, Rothmayer (7th Edition, Wiley)
A physical introduction to fluid mechanics, A. J. Smits, Wiley, NY 2000
degree: Materials Science and Engineering — Πτυχίο Τμήματος Επιστήμης και Μηχανικής Υλικών (first cycle, 240 ECTS, curriculum ΕΜΥ)
